description: This file defines a Redux slice for authentication state management, including initial state, reducers for login/logout actions, and exports for actions and reducer.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sets loading to true indicating a login attempt is in progress.

methods.name: loginSuccess
methods.description: Updates currentUser, sets isAuthenticated to true, and loading to false upon successful login.

methods.name: loginError
methods.description: Sets error message, marks user as unauthenticated, and stops loading upon login failure.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Sets loading to true indicating a logout attempt is in progress.

methods.name: logoutSuccess
methods.description: Resets auth state to unauthenticated, clears currentUser and error, and stops loading.
